verdict.rationale: Calendly's own docs say users can "fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits" and sync calendars for conflict checks. That supports defining custom availability schedules, which implies working hours. Neither date-specific overrides nor out-of-office periods are explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit working-hours configuration docs, date override support, out-of-office/vacation blocking, hands-on corroboration.
